idea-plugin.name: JetBrains Notes & TODOs
idea-plugin.description:
JetBrains Notes and TODOs provides an integrated markdown note-taking and task-tracking solution embedded directly in your IDE's right tool window.

Key Features

  • Project Notes: Isolated project-specific notes stored directly in your workspace (.idea/notes/).
  • Global Notes: Centralized notepad shared across all your projects in WebStorm, PhpStorm, PyCharm, and IntelliJ IDEA.
  • TODOs Aggregation: Automatically indexes TODO comments in your codebase, links explanatory notes to tasks, and displays gutter icons in editor margins.
  • Markdown Support & Checklists: Full markdown rendering with interactive checkboxes (- [ ] / - [x]).
  • Hierarchical Folders: Organize notes with folders and subfolders.

Crafted by Kothea Studio for productive daily coding.
